hook: What if a five-lane highway became a leafy, pedestrian-friendly urban oasis?

sections.voiceover: What if a five-lane highway became a leafy, pedestrian-friendly urban oasis?
In Lancaster, California, officials transformed a five-lane section of Highway 14 in the Mojave Desert. How did they reshape such a busy thoroughfare?
The project replaced those 15,000 daily cars with a total reconstruction of 9 city blocks.

They turned West Lancaster Boulevard, formerly part of Highway 14, into a vibrant community center. This streetscape investment successfully revitalized the core of Lancaster, California, for the local community.
Now, 9 blocks serve as a vibrant, leafy oasis.
